plainText:
Hisao Egawa (Japanese: 江川央生 Egawa Hisao) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Egawa was born on September 13, 1962, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided his voice occasionally for during the . He then returned during , voicing the Battle Club owners, all called Don George, in Unova. Egawa is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
